anchors.description: Width of the tandem-axle box trailer's front flap door, measured as the horizontal chord across the front face between the left and right edge handles (both mounted at the outer edges of the front panel at the same height).
anchors.visible_evidence: The white ribbed front flap spans the entire front face of the trailer between two symmetric dark handles located at identical image height (y=556); the front face is bounded by vertical aluminium edge profiles and horizontal top and bottom rails, and the body sits on a tandem axle with drawbar and jockey wheel, matching a European 2-axle box/sales trailer whose external body width is typically about 2.0-2.1 m.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Brand and model are not identifiable from the image; the body width class is assumed to be the common EU tandem box-trailer width of about 2.03 m, with a plausible range of 1.8-2.3 m for narrow versus wide sales trailers. Both handles are inset only about 2 px from the panel edges (under 3 cm), so the handle-to-handle chord is about 2-3 cm shorter than the full panel width.
